references.text: The same expression "everlasting statute" (חֻקַּת עוֹלָם) is used regarding a festival celebration that shall be observed throughout all generations
The prohibition against doing work on the Sabbath with the same wording "you shall do no work" (כָּל־מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ)
Parallel text concerning the Day of Atonement with the same command not to do any work
The Sabbath commandment with the same expression that no work shall be done
The same wording "an everlasting statute in all your dwellings throughout all generations" is used regarding the Feast of Weeks
Parallel command concerning the Day of Atonement where no work shall be done
The prohibition against work repeated with the expression "no work shall be done"
